name: Misdirection
body:
You call upon the power of a patsy’s thoughts to build a distraction.

Prerequisite(s): Bluff 5 ranks

Benefit(s): When you attempt a Bluff check to tell a lie, you may designate a single creature or object that you incorporate into your lie. This can have one of several effects: Exalting a subject makes it seem more important than it really is. Creatures take a -1 penalty to AC against a creature and a -2 penalty on skill checks or attacks made against an object. Dismissing a subject to make it seem beneath notice causes creatures to take a -1 penalty on attack rolls made against a creature and a -1 penalty on saves generated by an object. You may also distract attention to create a distraction for another creature you designate, allowing them to hide using Stealth or cause the target of your Bluff to become unable to make attacks of opportunity against that creature before the start of their next turn.
